errors.text_span: Способността на линиите е да се разглеждат като една цялостна крива
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly treats the two distinct data series (a solid line and a series of points) as a single curve. The prompt requires describing each line separately, but the description merges them, failing to describe the chart's actual structure.

The description focuses almost exclusively on the solid line's trajectory, such as the flat section between 2019 and 2020. It completely fails to describe the trend of the second data series (the points), which shows a continuous increase during that same period. The prompt required a description of each line.
